import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def tryf(name,f,p0):
    best=None
    for s in range(6):
        p=np.array(p0)*(1+0.3*np.random.randn(len(p0))) if s else np.array(p0,float)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: f(q)-dP_dt, p, max_nfev=5000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(name, np.mean((f(best.x)-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), np.round(best.x,4))
